schema.description: The person's own estimate of how well they kept to one course over a period, stated on a date (SELF-LOG.md section 6). Written by hand into a records file; Anam stores the figure and does not judge it, and a later estimate is a new facet, not a correction. No row has been written yet. Named health.medication-compliance (v1) until its name gained a third segment.

course.description: Which course of the drug the estimate is about, as in the med.regimen series.

date.description: The day the estimate was made, YYYY-MM-DD. This is the fact time, not the period.

drug.description: The generic drug name in lower case, matching the drug of the course's health.medication.started row.

estimate.description: The share of doses the person reckons they took over the period, as a fraction (0.95 for 95%). Their figure, not computed. The gate admits 0 to 1; internal/regimen derives an expected-dose schedule from it on demand and needs it above 0. Probable doses are never stored.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the writer. No convention is fixed yet; the package tests use the self-log prefix, est, the drug, the course and a month.

note.description: Anything the person said alongside the figure.

period_end.description: The last day the estimate covers, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

period_start.description: The first day the estimate covers, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

source_note.description: Where the estimate was recorded and in what words. Writer's text.
